name: Rindoh
source:
Likes: Sake, women
Dislikes: Sweets
Hobby: Singing
Home: Autumn Village

A daredevil who wears a dangerous air.

Rindoh is a ninja from the Autumn Village's ninja team called the White Tiger School. His ancestor is Benkei Musashibo, a monk-soldier, who was the first retainer of Yoshitsune Minamoto.

Possessing very high fighting skills and respected by his teammates, he deserves to be a leader of the White Tigers. However, he likes being an assistant or an advisor most of the time, saying that "he's not the type to be a leader."

He looks out for Kikyo, who is also a descendant of a ninja, just like him.

Although people rely on Rindoh, it is rare for him to rely on anyone, which makes his inner feelings hard to grasp.

[From in-game profile]
